title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Public agency listings validated from their complete descriptions. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.

notes_sections.heading: Eligibility and geographic exclusions
items: Site Reliability Engineer — financial services client (Job 155055): posted 18 hours ago; Toronto is the only disclosed location and the full posting does not confirm remote eligibility or office cadence.

Senior Manager, Technology Services (Job 154999): fully on-site in Ottawa. The role is also multidisciplinary people management rather than an SRE, Platform, or DevOps individual-contributor role; salary is CAD $110,000–$134,000/year.
Senior Infrastructure Engineer — banking client (Job 154922): Toronto hybrid two days weekly, potentially increasing to four; outside the reachable-city list.
Senior Systems Administrator — public-sector client (Job 155005): requires residence in Metro Vancouver and 50% on-site attendance.
Senior Infrastructure Operations Lead — energy and resources client (Job 154962): Calgary office attendance starts at five days/week and later becomes four.
Application Release Engineer III — financial-services client (Job 154805): Toronto hybrid two days weekly; outside the reachable-city list.

notes_sections.heading: Scope exclusions
items: Five of the 14 unique postings centered on network engineering, network design/operations, CyberArk systems support, or intermediate network automation rather than the target SRE, Platform, Infrastructure automation, or DevOps families.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Eight default searches were completed, with the first eight displayed results reviewed for each. The q= parameter remained a weak ranking signal and produced heavy overlap.
The Crown Corporation DevSecOps role matches an existing applications.md row. Its Secret-clearance residency requirement remains an eligibility item to confirm.
The Senior DevOps Specialist requires Toronto or Waterloo attendance once every two weeks. It is retained as occasional attendance, but the travel burden should be confirmed before proceeding.
The AWS Cloud Engineer is fully remote but hard-gated technically by its requirement for 5+ years of AWS infrastructure, networking, security, IAM, Landing Zone, CloudFormation, and CDK.
No posting was inaccessible. No CAPTCHA or verification challenge appeared, and no Apply, registration, alert, login, or form control was used.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 refresh delta
items: Site Reliability Engineer — financial services client (Job 155055): now listed as posted two days ago. It is a strong Python, GitHub Actions, observability, RCA, MTTR and automation match, but Toronto is the only disclosed location and the complete posting still does not confirm remote eligibility or office cadence.

Senior Cloud Platform Engineer — Azure & Databricks (Job 154794): still an excellent Azure, Terraform, Ansible, Databricks, CI/CD and financial-services match, but the contract requires four days per week at 79 Wellington Street in Toronto.
All three retained postings remain active on September 18, 2026; none is currently flagged expired.
